claims: Sporting CP defeated Bodø/Glimt 5-3 on aggregate in the UEFA Champions League.
Sporting CP won the second leg 5-0 after extra time against Bodø/Glimt.
The second leg was on March 17, 2026.
Sporting CP overcame a 3-0 first-leg deficit against Bodø/Glimt.
The second leg was at Estadio Jose Alvalade.
Sporting CP had 66% possession in the second leg.
Bodø/Glimt had 34% possession in the second leg.
Sporting CP had 38 total shots in the second leg.
Bodø/Glimt had 9 total shots in the second leg.
Sporting CP had 14 shots on target in the second leg.
Bodø/Glimt had 3 shots on target in the second leg.
Sporting CP had an expected goals value of 3.35 in the second leg.
Bodø/Glimt had an expected goals value of 0.54 in the second leg.
Sporting CP had 16 corners in the second leg.
Bodø/Glimt had 4 corners in the second leg.
Bodø/Glimt won the first leg 3-0 against Sporting CP on March 11, 2026 in Norway.
Bodø/Glimt's first-leg goals were scored by Fet, Blomberg, and Høgh.
Second-leg goals for Sporting CP were scored by Inácio, Gonçalves, Suárez, Araújo, and Nel.
FotMob News reports that Inácio scored in the first half of the second leg.
FotMob News reports that Gonçalves scored at 61' in the second leg.
FotMob News reports that Suárez scored a penalty in the 78th minute of the second leg.
FotMob News reports that Gonçalves' 61' goal and Suárez's 78th-minute penalty levelled the aggregate score.
FotMob News reports that the second leg went to extra time.
ESPN notes that Maximiliano Araújo scored at 92' in the second leg.
ESPN notes that Rafael Nel scored at 120+1' in the second leg.
This was the first time in Champions League history a team has overturned a three-goal deficit in the knockout rounds to advance outside of the qualifiers.
BBC Sport reports that Sporting CP reached the Champions League quarter-finals.
